# vss (value-screen-sentinel)

> A command-line tool that watches a hand-maintained list of companies:
> it fetches prices, reads the companies' own reports, values a company
> from the cash it makes, and sends a phone message only when something
> changed. The tool measures; a person decides. Not financial advice.
